hook.text: Before any medical procedure, the patient must understand risks and agree freely. This was not always the rule.

buildup.text: For centuries, doctors decided for patients. 'Doctor knows best' was the norm. Patients were told nothing.

discovery.text: Informed consent emerged from horrific abuses: Nazi experiments, the Tuskegee syphilis study.

twist.text: Full information can overwhelm patients. Some prefer not to know every risk.

climax.text: Informed consent balances autonomy with care. Too little information denies choice. Too much paralyzes the chooser.

punchline.text: Know the risks, choose freely. Informed consent was born from past abuse.

quiz.question: Why was informed consent established?
options: Past abuses like the Tuskegee study showed patients need to understand and agree to risks
